# Function: minDynamicColor()

```ts
function minDynamicColor(value?, resolution?): Color;
```

Sampled component-wise minimum in working color space; unreadable values return black. Inputs are not mutated.

## Parameters

### value?

[`DynamicValue`](../type-aliases/DynamicValue.md)\<`ColorRepresentation`\> = `0`

### resolution?

`number` = `16`

## Returns

`Color`
